approval_basis: User requested completion and reporting of each phase before approving the next phase.

proposed_work.scope: Analyze archived yaw/lateral displacement, full quaternion rotation and body/world velocity contributions, integration residuals and onset trends across the registered entry-flat, transition and slope portions.
proposed_work.comparison_rule: Compare applicable Flat, rough and older uphill archives only with explicit revision, geometry, seed and telemetry differences; do not pool them into a success rate or infer causation from correlation.
deliverables: evidence limitations and unresolved causal questions

proposed_work.scope: Prepare diagnostic capture at the actual boundary predicate evaluation, before automatic reset, with no acceptance or geometry changes.
required_fields: body world positions and linear velocities
per-body/per-axis current and predicted out-of-bounds flags
environment ID, terrain row/column, index validity and selected origin
safe lower/upper limits, collision radius, margin and control period
nonfinite-input flags and final per-environment termination flag
proposed_work.reset_rule: Copy the exact evaluated inputs and flags before reset; preserve the terminal record across reset and distinguish subsequent state.
proposed_work.termination_reporting: Expose the existing source_terrain_tile_bounds term and available branch attribution without inventing absent historical telemetry.

proposed_work.scope: Check diagnostic flag equivalence to the unchanged guard, current/prediction/invalid branches, boundary equality, environment selection and pre/post-reset capture. Freeze any modified runtime inputs and prepare a separately reviewable future protocol.
proposed_work.runtime_rule: No GPU run in this offline phase. Any later same-case runtime validation requires separate approval after offline results; no terrain sweep, seed search or training.

acceptance: Original failed-run evidence, frozen preparation and prior archives remain unchanged.
Drift findings distinguish directly recorded facts, kinematic accounting and unresolved causal hypotheses.
New diagnostics faithfully expose the existing full predicate, including fail-closed cases, without relaxing it.
Relevant CPU checks pass and new source hashes and future protocol are reviewable.
No simulation, retry, other-terrain run, policy/reward/threshold change or PPO initialization occurs.
rule: This file is a proposal only. Implement the offline work after the next user phase approval; report the result before seeking any later runtime approval.
